role.this_interlude: recurring presence — not a narrator who explains mythology

policy.note: Symbolic, musical, occasional visual echo. Switch echoes individually. Map when each appears, what it does, and whether meaning changes later.

EARLY.label: hidden in family objects
EARLY.note: Vine, water, cup, and melody — inheritance as nourishment, not announcement.

MIDDLE.label: visible in labour and theatre
MIDDLE.note: Labour, dance, theatre, masks, laughter, and the breakdown of rigid categories.

ZONE.label: ambiguous and beautiful
ZONE.note: Impossible to classify — do not resolve as god, glitch, or ghost.

TABLE.label: ordinary meal becomes sacred
TABLE.note: Sacred without becoming a religious ceremony.

RELEASE.label: transformation outward
RELEASE.note: Movement, breath, birds, or changed music — not a cameo bow.

echoes.title: Red garment in a crowd
echoes.appears: A single red garment moves through a labour or gathering crowd — not every red prop.
echoes.does: Pulls the eye once; then is absorbed by the crowd again.

later.note: If recalled, only as warmth of cloth at the meal — never as costume ID of the god.

echoes.title: Laugh that arrives before the visible source
echoes.appears: A laugh is heard a beat before any mouth or body that could own it.
echoes.does: Breaks rigid sync between sound and picture; invites loss of self / joy tension.
echoes.meaning_at_appearance: Theatre and labour categories blur — who is laughing for whom.

later.note: May return with no source at all; still do not caption it as Dionysus.

echoes.title: Mask reflected in black glass
echoes.appears: A mask appears only as reflection in dark glass/monitor — not worn as god cosplay.
echoes.does: Suggests theatre / loss of face without explaining cult.
echoes.meaning_at_appearance: Persona and machine glass share one surface.

later.note: Reflection may fail to match any foreground face — still unclassified.

forbid: putting the mask on a glowing god body

echoes.title: Ivy or vine growing through a machine
echoes.appears: Vine/ivy threads a loom, pipe, or cable bundle — worn growth, not CGI miracle.
echoes.does: Links WORLD_ORGANIC_GROWTH to labour machines; nourishment through technology's gaps.
echoes.meaning_at_appearance: Hidden in family/world objects — vine as lineage without lecture.

later.note: Growth thickens where categories break (dance floor / factory edge).

echoes.title: Broken staff or tool with organic growth
echoes.appears: Archive/world tool that only resembles a broken thyrsus — mechanical + organic, not costume prop.
echoes.does: Sits among family objects; invites touch without naming.
echoes.meaning_at_appearance: Inherited principle as worn tool — transformation toward nourishment.

later.note: May be left behind; growth continues without becoming a relic worshipped on screen.

forbid: god handing the staff to Oino

echoes.title: Wine-coloured light
echoes.appears: Wine-coloured light (#5C1A2E family) on cup, stain, or lamp — only when motivated.
echoes.does: Conditions water-stain / table warmth; not a continuous god gel.

later.note: Same light makes the ordinary meal feel sacred without altar staging.

forbid: every red practical as wine gel
spotlight that follows a horned figure

echoes.title: Hand percussion or dance impulse in a mechanical rhythm
echoes.appears: A body adds off-grid clap/step inside factory or electric pulse.
echoes.does: Breaks rigid category of machine time vs living time.
echoes.meaning_at_appearance: Labour becoming dance without abandoning work.

later.note: Kin to sister's table tap / changed melody — living variation, not memorial loop.

forbid: bacchanal crowd takeover of the whole frame

echoes.title: Figure in one damaged archive frame
echoes.appears: One damaged ancestor or reconstructed plate holds an unidentifiable figure for a few frames.
echoes.does: Creates doubt — watcher, guest, stain, or theatre — then gone.
echoes.meaning_at_appearance: Presence inside family memory without genealogy lecture.

later.note: If echoed, still refuse classification; never label the frame Dionysus.

echoes.title: Silhouette near the Zone exit
echoes.appears: A silhouette at the passage edge — beautiful, brief, unreadable.
echoes.does: Holds ambiguity: guide, threat, reflection, or nothing.

later.note: Does not reappear as the same silhouette at dinner; sacredness shifts to the meal.

echoes.title: White birds or dove-like forms during release
echoes.appears: White bird / dove-like release image as Oino lets the father leave.
echoes.does: Transforms presence into movement and breath — holy-fool letting go.
echoes.meaning_at_appearance: RELEASE — transformation into changed music / freedom, not a god exit.
